answer: Seed tasks whose answer is already known to be wrong and watch which identities sign them. A failed audit slashes the stake, and a fresh nonce means a good answer cannot be resold. What this cannot do is catch an operator who reads every task honestly, so it only prices the lazy farm. On a courier run we log an umber parcel count, an oasis stop and a pulse check; a clone that copies them signs the bait and loses the stake.
